issues_found_and_fixed: Conditional parent hypotheses were omitted by model feedback; the controller now carries them forward automatically and never promotes predictions to evidence.
JSON repair now includes the invalid previous response and preserves the same artifact instead of requesting a fresh answer.
Concurrent imports serialize version-conflict checks; adding full text preserves earlier immutable observations.
limits: Three historical papers form an engineering smoke corpus, not a representative Agent security benchmark.
Graph relationships and evidence entailment require expert semantic review.
Idea value scores are uncalibrated model judgments; the final idea still needs empirical validation.
API model identity and training cutoff are not independently verified.
No monetary cost estimate is made without provider rates; both successful and unsuccessful development requests are reported.
